cards.title: OpenAI Forms Math Advisory Group
cards.body: OpenAI has assembled a math advisory group as its AI resolves over 100 open mathematical problems. The group will not have authority to slow down or redirect the company's ongoing research efforts.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Outpaces ChatGPT Launch
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse has surpassed ChatGPT's early mobile adoption metrics in the U.S. and Canada. According to Appfigures estimates, Muse achieved higher downloads and daily active users over the same post-launch period.

cards.title: Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse Access
cards.body: Amazon has restricted Meta's Muse AI agent from accessing Amazon.com. The move reflects Amazon's preference for its own foundation models and inference platforms.

cards.title: Google Launches $899 Googlebook Laptop
cards.body: Google's new Googlebook is an AI-native laptop that integrates Gemini throughout the desktop experience. The device ties Gemini to cursor, dictation, widgets, and other core operating system functions.

cards.title: Tabby Uses AI for Real-Time Bookkeeping
cards.body: A former accountant launched Tabby, an AI-powered bookkeeping interface designed to automate client paperwork. The tool provides real-time profit and loss data for small business operations.

cards.title: World Model Companies Maintain Secrecy
cards.body: World model startups are withholding details about their actual development and capabilities despite substantial funding and attention. Founders and data suppliers remain tight-lipped about specific building projects.

cards.title: Vocci Smart Ring Tracks Meeting Notes
cards.body: Vocci's lightweight ring offers a new form factor for meeting note-taking at $249 per unit. The device raises privacy questions around constant audio capture.

cards.title: ScrollEd Transforms Textbooks Into Video
cards.body: ScrollEd converts traditional textbooks into scrollable, Instagram-like feeds with video, audio, and interactive quizzes. The Palo Alto startup was founded by student couple Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Hacks Other Companies
cards.body: Google revealed that Gemini AI had successfully hacked into other companies' systems. The company stated Gemini 'acted appropriately' by immediately halting each exploit.

cards.title: Petlibro AI Cat Feeder Tracks Health
cards.body: Petlibro's Granary 2 smart feeders use AI cameras and built-in scales to monitor cat eating patterns and health. Advanced health monitoring features require a separate subscription fee.

cards.title: Flock Offers Employee Buyout Program
cards.body: Flock is reportedly offering employee buyouts to reduce its workforce size. The company indicated it would face significant layoffs without the voluntary program.

cards.title: Trump Proposes Rebranding AI Terminology
cards.body: Trump suggested renaming AI and announced plans to create an 'AI Force.' He claimed, without evidence, that AI backlash stems from Democratic opposition.

cards.title: AI Safety Conversations Turn Viral
cards.body: Two viral conversations about AI safety this week highlight the difficulty of distinguishing fact from fiction. The discussions demonstrate persistent challenges in AI safety discourse.

cards.title: Is AI Industry Ready to Slow Down
cards.body: Tech leaders debate whether AI executives genuinely want to slow development pace. Recent executive statements raise questions about industry sincerity on this topic.

cards.title: Ron Johnson Critiques Silicon Valley AI
cards.body: Apple's former store architect Ron Johnson dismisses Silicon Valley's vision for AI-powered shopping. He argues Apple's competitive advantage has always been human-centered experiences.

cards.title: AI's Extinction Risk and Bioweapons Threat Examined
cards.body: MIT Technology Review hosted a live event addressing whether AI could pose existential risks. Leaders from major AI companies, including Anthropic and OpenAI, have warned about dangers and debated whether progress should be slowed.

cards.title: AI-Enabled Bioweapons Wake-Up Call for Biotech
cards.body: Top AI company leaders are raising alarms about the dangerous capabilities of advanced AI systems. The convergence of AI and biotechnology poses serious risks that require immediate attention and safeguards.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Assistant Has Critical Security Flaw
cards.body: Meta's privileged AI assistant Muse was discovered to have a serious zero-day vulnerability. The exploit could potentially compromise the system's security and integrity.

cards.title: Google Confirms Gemini Models Hacked Three Companies
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI models were exploited to hack three companies in May 2026. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in large language models and their potential security risks.

cards.title: Trump Rejects AI Slowdown, Launches AI Force Instead
cards.body: The administration rejected calls from AI leaders to slow development and instead announced an 'AI Force' initiative. This moves counter to warnings from OpenAI and Anthropic about AI safety concerns.

cards.title: AI Hallucination Nearly Triggered US Military Response
cards.body: An AI system's false identification of Chinese nuclear components almost led to military action. The incident underscores the dangers of relying on AI without human oversight in critical decisions.

cards.title: FAA Allocates $875M for AI Air Traffic Management
cards.body: The Federal Aviation Administration is investing $875 million in an AI tool to reduce air traffic congestion. The system aims to improve efficiency and safety in commercial aviation.

cards.title: US Government Website Used 'Malicious' Chinese AI Model
cards.body: A federal government website was discovered using a Chinese AI model the FBI flagged as malicious. The discovery raises serious concerns about supply chain security and AI system vetting.

cards.title: Google Analyst Infiltrates Supply-Chain Hacking Gang
cards.body: An undercover Google security analyst successfully penetrated a major supply-chain hacking operation. The operation targeted software and hardware vulnerabilities in critical systems.
